text: Every comment counts: no more one move per person per hour
Top savers and killers in the pinned comments
Colors: add a color word to paint your cells
Up to 3 moves per person per generation; a pattern's name alone lands it
Tails: cells fade out as they die
Extra moves wait their turn instead of being skipped
Schedule a move: add a time, like "rpent 40,30 in 1h"
The live page says where each move came from (the live chat, or which video)
